about: Admission test vectors. Language-neutral: each case names FACTS about the input and the REQUIRED disposition, never our object layout. Any implementation in any language can be held to this file.
how_to_read: given = what holds of the request. expect.admitted = may the proposition be taken as a premise. expect.disposition = the REQUIRED name of the outcome; collapsing two dispositions into one is a failure even when admitted matches.

cases.why: everything holds: source supports, epoch current, guards clear, source eligible for this purpose
the search missed. A miss is not support and never becomes one
checked exhaustively, the source says nothing. MUST NOT collapse into V02: a miss and a silence are different diseases
the source says the opposite. Distinct from both above
a certificate minted for another epoch does not silently authorise use in this one
guard conservation was never evaluated. A check that can be forgotten is a hole by default, so silence is refusal, not passage
the source carried a guard and the claim dropped it: the support was said about a DIFFERENT proposition
the source supports the claim but is not eligible for THIS purpose. Support is not eligibility

evidence attributed to a different source than the certificate was issued for. Наш разряд — CERTIFICATE_INVALID: «поддержано где-то» не есть «поддержано ЭТИМ источником». Чужая реализация вправе назвать иначе, но обязана НЕ ДОПУСТИТЬ и назвать причину
proposition bytes changed after minting: the recomputed digest no longer matches the claimed one
CONTROL for V10. An untouched certificate must verify, otherwise V10 proves nothing
two eligible sources disagree. Forbidden: majority vote, recency, confidence, asking a model to reconcile. The conflict must reach the caller AS a conflict

gate_cases.why: CONTROL. A row grounded on another ROW is internal and not the gate's business. A gate that demotes everything would pass the rest of this file while guarding nothing
external ground, no admission receipt: demoted to zfl2's own zero-trust default rather than rejected loudly
a grounding certificate proves support, never the right to decide. The authority axis has its own gate and it is not this one
the receipt does not belong to this proposition
the gate returns a COPY. The caller must be able to show the original and the gated version side by side

A check that can be forgotten is a hole by default. If the caller supplies no guard verdict, the gate refuses — it does not pass quietly. This vector previously pinned a DEFECT (the socket was not wired at all, so nothing could ever be admitted); the socket was wired 2026-08-28 and the vector was rewritten deliberately, which is exactly what it was written to force.
the live path: a valid receipt AND a CLEAR guard verdict is the ONLY road to admission. If this fails, the boundary refuses everything and guards nothing
the source carried a guard the claim dropped: support was said about a DIFFERENT proposition. The refusal must name the GUARDS, not the receipt
